page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number "11" at top left. Main text in the centre-right column of verse and headings; marginal notes in the left margin beside the verse, in small type. No text below the main text.

p.i:
Pigram in planiciem stagnantes egerit undas,
Quas auget veniens, refluúsque reciprocat æstus.
Sed gelidas à fronte sedet sublimis ad Arctos
Vrbs impolita ingo, pronúmque excurrit in æquor
Et tuta æterno defendit mœnia fluctu.

p.note: Tartessos oppidum. Claudian. in Rufinum li.1. Palingen. Arics. Idem in Tauro.
p.i:
Non Tartessiacis illum satiaret arenis
Tempesta pretiosa Tagi.
Et Tartessiaci resonabunt littora ponti.
--Quà Titan populos despectat Eoos,
Et Tartessiaca pronus quà mergitur unda.

p.note: Emerita oppidum. Ausonius de claris Vrbibus.
p.i:
Iure mihi post has memorabere nomen Iberum
Emerita: æquoreus quam præterlabitur amnis.
Submittit cui tota suos Hispania fasces.
Corduba non non arce potens, tibi Tarraco certant,
Quaeq; sinu pelagi iactat se Bracara dines.

Vnclis Batica prouocas tapetis.
Lucanum potes imputare terris,
Hoc plus quàm Senecam dedisse mundo,
Aut dulcem generasse Gallionem.
Attollat refluos in astra fontes
Graio nobilior Melete Batis.
Batim Mantua prouocare noli.

page.notes: Marginal notes are in the left margin; the note "Bracara op." and the verse-line notes are placed beside the lines they stand against. Some letters in the verse are uncertain due to print damage and faded ink, notably "Tempesta" and "Quaeq;". Bottom margin blank.
